name: Martial Arts (Krav Maga)
description: Krav Maga was developed by Israeli Special Forces in conjunction with the US government - the project's goal was to produce a brutal, efficient, quick-learned martial art that was effective in disabling opponents quickly in open combat.  Krav Maga uses instinctive movements aggressive counter attacks and a no-holds-barred mentality without the ceremonial elements of traditional martial arts. Krav Maga by design stresses efficiency, aggression and, above all, survival. This design philosophy resulted in traditional elements of martial arts practice like forms, katas, and rules for competition, being omitted from Krav Maga training, so in addition to the previously mentioned striking and grappling techniques, Krav Maga also teaches techniques like headbutts, groin strikes, strikes to the back of the head, eye gouges, and throat strikes.  There are no rules on the battlefield, thus there is no consideration for rules or “fairness” in Krav Maga. The only “rule” is to win. The only success is survival.    “I began fighting anti-Semitism in the ’30s. When the Hitler youth gangs used to single out Jewish young men on the streets, it was either hit or run. I found the hitting more satisfying.” - Founder Imi Lichtenfeld    “Krav Maga heightens perception and transforms fear into something more productive.” - Founder Imi Lichtenfeld     Technique: Groin Strike      No Requirement.     Instead of making 2 Attacks with your Martial Arts attack action, you can choose to make a Groin Strike. Use your action to make an aimed attack against the opponent's body, except that aimed attack is made with a -4 penalty, rather than a -8. If successful and the opponent does not have Pain Editor cyberware, that opponent must make a DV17 Endurance or Resist Torture/Drugs check; on failure, they drop any held items and become suppressed. If they fail the check by 5 or more, they also fall prone. Damage dealt with this strike is inflicted as normal; if the damage reduces the target to 0 HP, the target is unconscious, but stable.     Technique: Erratic Aggression      Requirement:      You dodged all Melee Attacks that were targeted at you during an opponent's turn (minimum 1), and have not used this ability since the start of the round.      Once per round when you fulfill this requirement at the end of an opponent's turn, you may use your Martial Arts Special Resolution to make one attack against an opponent which has just attacked you; the DV for that attack is the result of the enemy's last melee attack roll made against you.   Recovery     No Requirement: All Martial Arts Forms may use this Move.    Whenever you use the Get Up Action, you can attempt to beat a DV13 with the Martial Arts Special Move Resolution. If you succeed, that Get Up Action didn't cost an Action.

name: Martial Arts (Bojutsu)
description: Bojutsu     Bojutsu is a conjunction of martial arts of several different styles, primarily Karate, except specialized towards the use of a polearm/bowstaff. It allows fighters to add extra punch to their attacks without need for excessive muscle, while also remaining at range.    Bōjutsu (Japanese: 棒術, lit. 'staff technique') is the martial art of stick fighting using a bō, which is the Japanese word for staff. Some techniques involve slashing, swinging, and stabbing with the staff. Others involve using the staff as a vaulting pole or as a prop for hand-to-hand strikes.   Thrusting, swinging, and striking techniques often resemble empty-hand movements, following the philosophy that the bō is merely an "extension of one’s limbs". Consequently, bōjutsu is often incorporated into other styles of empty-hand fighting, like traditional Jū-jutsu, and karate.      General Requirement:  Bojutsu techniques can only be utilized while wielding a polearm/bowstaff/etc. in both hands. These weapons are considered to be Heavy Melee weapons, and are typically around 6 feet long.    When wielding such a weapon, you may make attacks from up to 2 meters/yards (one space) away, and may add 1 to the weapons ROF.    You may use the martial arts skill when attacking with such weapons. Note: this assumes use of  Cyber-Augmented Melee  to add damage to attacks.     Technique: Polearm Master      Requirement:      You have not yet used this ability, this round.      On an enemy's turn, when an enemy comes within 2 m/yds of your position, you may make a martial arts attack against them which they dodge as normal.     Technique: Sentinel      Requirement:      You hit a target with an attack this turn, and have not yet used this ability, this round.      Use the Martial Arts Special Move Resolution to attempt to beat a DV15. Upon success, the move characteristic of an opponent you attacked is reduced by 5 (minimum 1) until the start of your next turn. If you succeeded the check by 5 or more, the enemy also falls prone.

description: The Japanese martial art of Aikido is a comprehensive system of throwing, joint-locking, striking and pinning techniques turning the opponent's power against themselves, coupled with training in traditional Japanese weapons such as the sword, staff and knife. According to the founder's philosophy, the primary goal in the practice of aikido is to overcome oneself instead of cultivating violence or aggressiveness.     “To injure an opponent is to injure yourself. To control aggression without inflicting injury is the Art of Peace.” - Founder Morihei Ueshiba      "Aikido is the principle of non-resistance. Because it is non-resistant, it is victorious from the beginning. Those with evil intentions or contentious thoughts are instantly vanquished. Aikido is invincible because it contends with nothing." - O-Sensei   Morihei Ueshiba      "If your opponent strikes with fire, counter with water, becoming completely fluid and free-flowing. Water, by its nature, never collides with or breaks against anything. On the contrary, it swallows up any attack harmlessly." - Morihei Ueshiba     Disarming Combination   Requirement: You hit the same target with a Brawling Attack and a Martial Arts Attack this Turn. Once per Turn when you fulfill this requirement, you can use the Martial Arts Special Move Resolution to attempt to beat a DV15.  Gas Jet sprays a burst of 3 doses of a Street Drug or 3 Vials of Poison/Biotoxin into a 3x3 square directly in front of the shooter (similar to Shotgun Shell attack). Can be used one-handed and is virtually undetectable even without a Conceal check. 
 All susceptible targets in range suffer the effects of the drug or poison. Targets equipped with gear that neutralizes gas attacks (Nasal Filters & Anti-Smog Breathing Mask) are not affected. Gas Jet must be loaded with 3 more doses after each shot before firing again.

name: Bag Lady Chic Hat
description: Follow the latest dumpster diver fashion trends! Torn and worn out clothes, perfect if you want that homeless look.

name: Fire Safe
description:
Small fireproof lockbox made of Thick Steel. 
 
 50HP 
 30cm / 1ft 
 Can be picked with a DV15 Pick Lock Skill Check

name: Heavy Pistol (Basic)
description: Basic ammo, nothing special.

name: Neural Link
description: Access to nervous system.

name: High Fashion Bottoms
description: Made from the most expensive quality materials and by the most exclusive producers, this is what you wear when you've made it. The kind of fashion you see supermodels wearing in videos on the Citinet.

name: Tomahawk
description: A light axe that can be thrown.

name: DNA Lock
description: Uses biometrics to lock the cyberdeck. Requires DV17 Electronics/Security Tech Check to crack.

name: Bug Detector
description: Notifies of bugs or taps within 2m/yds.

name: Solo of Fortune Bodypillow
description:
Bodypillow with the image of a famous Solo from the 2020s (such as Morgan Blackhand, BoaBoa Weyland, or Adam Smasher). 
 20 inches x 54 inches (50.8 cm x 137.16 cm), except for the Adam Smasher pillow which is considerably larger.

name: Budget Chipware Socket
description: A cheap socket for a single installation of chipware. Damage to the head sends the installed chipware 30 m/yds away, potentially breaking it (see Black Chrome pg. 17 for more details).

name: Kestrel 2
description:
Black ICE can’t hit what they can’t catch. 
 7 slots only for Programs. 
 Right after Jacking In, Netrunner can activate a maximum of 2 installed Speedy Gonzalvez Programs without a NET Action.

name: Modular Finger Enthusiast Cyberhand
description:
Borgware. Requires cyberarm. Comes with 8 cyberfingers*. (see Black Chrome pg. 18 for more details) 
 *Fingers must be added after installation

name: Lawman
description: Renegade defenders, corporate strike teams, or the last remnants of a government police force, they patrol the streets to enforce some order in an otherwise lawless world.

name: KRASH Barrier
description: Cyberdeck is immune to effects that force the Netrunner to Jack Out (safely or unsafely).

name: Dragon Flamethrower
description: Fire at your finger tips. Can only fire Incendiary Shotgun Shells, but targets ignited by this weapon burn for 4HP a turn.

name: Kraken
description: Effect: Does 3d6 damage direct to an enemy Netrunner's brain. Until the end of the Netrunner's next Turn, the Netrunner cannot progress deeper into the Architecture or Jack Out safely (The Netrunner can still perform an unsafe Jack Out).

name: Rapid Assault
description: An all-purpose shotgun.

name: Subdermal Pocket
description: 2x4 inch underskin pocket

name: Superchrome® Sidearm
description: The Superchrome® Sidearm is an Exotic Very Heavy Pistol. Gives the user a +2 bonus to Wardrobe and Style when equipped. Full rules can be found in Black Chrome on Page 121.

name: Very Heavy Pistol (Excellent)
description: A very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed. +1 to Attack.

name: Urban
description: Bring out the big guns. This rocket launcher will do some damage.

name: Killer
description: Effect: Deals 4d6 damage to a Program. If this damage would be enough to Derezz the Program, it is instead Destroyed.

name: Chainmail Armor (Head)
description: Armor made up of innumerable metal rings for your head. -2 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

name: Distilling Compound
description: This additive increases the Resist Torture/Drugs DV of Poison or Biotoxin Vials by 2. Mixing multiple Distilling Compounds does not increase Resist Torture/Drugs DV beyond the initial +2.

name: Medtech Bag
description: Medical equipment.

name: Shoulder Cam
description: A stowable camera that pops out of your shoulder. Can link with an agent or memory chip.

name: Arasaka Prototype Variable Assault Rifle
description: The Arasaka Prototype Variable Assault Rifle is an Excellent Quality Exotic Assault Rifle. Assuming you have all the parts, it can use an alternate unique railgun mode. Full rules can be found in Black Chrome on Page 102.

name: Midnight Lady Sexual Implant
description: Machine washable.

name: Bulletproof Glass
description:
Enclosure glass gains 7 HP. 
 Bike first requires the Enclosure upgrade to install this upgrade.

name: Armored Chassis
description: Can be applied to all vehicles. Armors the vehicle to SP13. Doesn't affect the glass.

name: Bag Lady Chic Top
description: Follow the latest dumpster diver fashion trends! Torn and worn out clothes, perfect if you want that homeless look.

name: Talon Foot
description: A retractable blade in your foot which is a Light Melee Weapon.

name: Medium Melee
description: Generic Medium Melee Weapon.

name: Urban Flash Glasses
description: The most technological and flashy clothing you can find in the Time of the Red.

name: WorldSat Aerial Sphere
description: When set up, provides access to a Citinet when within 50 miles of the city or of another set up WorldSat Aerial Sphere that is connected to the Citinet. For more information, see Black Chrome Page 50.

name: Heavy Melee (Excellent)
description:
Generic Excellent Quality Heavy Melee Weapon. 
 +1 to Attack.

name: Artificial Shoulder Mount
description: Allows you to install an extra pair of cyberarms.

name: Urban Flash Hat
description: The most technological and flashy clothing you can find in the Time of the Red.

name: Avenger
description: A concealable, medium-sized pistol. +1 to Attack.

name: Seating Upgrade
description:
Can be applied to all vehicles. Adds two seats to the vehicle. These can be installed as an external sidecar, they may also be installed as ejector seats with removable parachutes. 
 Can be taken multiple times with the exception of Bikes, Jetskis and Gyrocopters.

name: Wisp
description: Does 1d6 damage direct to the enemy Netrunner's brain and lowers the amount of total NET Actions the Netrunner can accomplish on their next Turn by 1 (minimum 2).

name: Scavenged Armor
description: A scavenged set of Light Armorjack body armor that is unable to be repaired. Refer to full item description on BC+ pg. 4.

name: Tomahawk (Excellent)
description: A light axe that can be thrown. +1 to Attack.

name: ModFire 10X (Rifle)
description: The ModFire 10X is an Exotic Heavy Pistol. Can also be transformed into an Exotic SMG or an Exotic Assault Rifle, assuming the user has all the needed parts. Full rules can be found in Black Chrome on Page 114.

name: Rifle (Expansive)
description: If you roll Foreign object Critical (see pg. 187), victim rolls for a second (different) Critical Injury. Second injury does not deal bonus damage.

name: Pocket Launcher
description: While unloaded, this weapon can be concealed.

name: Flak (Head)
description: Metal plated armor to resist the most powerful hits to your head. -4 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

name: NeuTongue
description:
Simulates flavor sensations. Use a linked Agent to customize flavor profiles. Can be deactivated without an Action. No sense of taste when deactivated. 
 Replaces Meat tongue.

name: Drum Magazine (Sniper Rifle)
description: Increases magazine size to a massive 12 bullets.

name: Crushed Windpipe
description: Cannot speak.

name: Aerie
description: Each installed Raven Black ICE destroys Programs instead of derezzing.

name: Skin Weave
description:
External Body Cyberware*. Head and Body Armor SP7 and recovers 1SP/day. Armor does not stack. 
  * Cyberware Armor does not function as armor in the system, please add the "Skin Weave" item to the character/mook to track

name: SH-45 Patroller
description:
One seat Gyrocopter. Civilian version. 
 Full stats can be found on page 58.

name: Shotgun Shell (Basic)
description: Basic ammo, nothing special.

name: JetBoy Hoverboard
description:
A hoverboard driven with Athletics Skill. Can't be upgraded. 
 Full details can be found on page 78.

name: Flare Gun
description:
As well as normal Grenade Ammunition, this weapon can fire road flares*. They don't deal any damage, but if fired into the air can be seen from 3 miles. You cannot install this weapon in Pop-up Cyberware. 
  *Currently not supported so will need to manually delete a road flare from actors inventory after firing

name: Blitzkrieg Arc-Thrower Cyberarm
description:
An “arm” in name only, the Arc-Thrower is a massive electricity cannon. 0 option slots. 
 The Arc-Thrower is One-Handed Exotic Poor Quality Shotgun that uses Heavy Weapons Skill. Fires “Shotgun Shell” electricity blast with 4d6 damage. Critical Injuries are not possible. Armor is not ablated. If target goes under 1HP from the blast, target has 1HP and is Unconscious. 
 Firing the Arc-Thrower consumes a charge from the included Radline MagnaSlot BatteryBrick (100eb). BatteryBrick has a 32 shot capacity and can be recharged in 1 hour. Use an Action to swap in a fresh battery pack even if user has no free hands available. Arc-Thrower does not have a hand attachment.

name: Drum Magazine (Assault Rifle)
description: Increases magazine size to a massive 45 bullets.

name: Hover Upgrade
description: Can be applied to all land vehicles. Adds fans onto the vehicle that allow it to traverse water at a narrative speed of 15 MPH/ 24KPH, and a combat speed of 10.

name: TR-4 Detonator Fluid
description: Must be poured into a fuel tank vehicle to explode. Full rules can be found on page 90.

name: Medium Pistol (Rubber)
description: Does not cause Critical Injury. Does not ablate armor. Leaves target at minimum 1hp. Counts as Basic ammo for exotic weapons

name: Rifle (Smart)
description: Req Targeting Scope Cyberware, otherwise won't fire. If miss single attack by 4 or less, roll second attack at same DV 1d10+10 (not normal stat). Can add luck. Target can dodge the second roll as normal if able to do so.

name: Kevlar (Head)
description: Standard Kevlar for your head. No armor penalty.

name: Bow
description: A revitalized bow, reloaded as part of an Attack Action.

name: Mimic Clothing (Urban Flash)
description: Light Armorjack made from a Mimic Clothing Kit and "Urban Flash" clothing. Refer to full item description on BC pg. 33.

name: Heavy SMG
description: A heavy SMG. Due to its size it can't be concealed.

name: Appetite Controller
description:
Suppresses hunger response. User ignores Humanity Loss penalties from starvation trauma but User can still starve. Roll a Death Save at start of 7th consecutive day without eating. +1 to successive Death Saves each day afterwards. 
 Requires Biomonitor.

name: Implanted Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame
description:
Requires 2 Interface Plugs 
 Increases BODY to 12 while plugged in 
 Does not affect HP or Deathsave 
 Stealth +2 
 
 Comes with two Excellent Quality Exotic Heavy Melee Weapons and one Excellent Quality Exotic Light Melee Weapon pre-installed*. 
 See Black Chrome pg. 52 for more details. 
  * Must be manually added.

name: Kerenzikov
description: Speedware. Permanent +2 to Initiative.

name: Bunker Gear
description: Fireproof flak armor with a built in gas mask and 30 minutes of oxygen in a tank that refills itself after an hour. -4 to REF, DEX, and MOVE. Refer to full item description on BC pg. 29.

name: Extended Magazine (Medium Pistol)
description: Increases magazine size to a hefty 18 bullets.

name: Hardened Shielding (Cyber Arm)
description: The arm and installed options are not affected by EMP effects.

name: Heavy SMG (Excellent)
description: A heavy SMG. Due to its size it can't be concealed. +1 to Attack.

name: Beast Shotgun
description: The Midnight Arms Beast Shotgun is an Exotic Shotgun. Its magazine holds 40 rounds. Requires BODY 10 or higher (unless mounted) when fired or the User will suffer the consequences. Full rules can be found in Black Chrome on Page 111.

name: Scarlet Blackbow
description: A revitalized bow that must be reloaded after every attack. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the bow's battery pack explodes. Comes bundeled with a Quiver and 6 Rubber Arrows.

name: Homing Tracer
description: Audio tracking of a tracer up to 1 mile. Replacements not included.

name: MonoVision
description:
Single-optic Cybereye visor that takes the place of two meat eyes. Too large for a MultiOptic Mount.  
 Cybereye Options are always “paired” even if there is only one of each type. Penalties from Lost Eye Critical Injury are doubled if the target solely relies on the Monovision for sight. 
 Borgware.

name: Communications Center
description: Can be applied to all vehicles. Touchscreen console that functions as an Agent, along with a storage unit containing 6  Radio Communicators , 6  Scrambler/Descramblers , a  Radio Scanner/Music Player , a  Homing tracer  with 6 tracers, and an  Audio Recorder .

name: Very Heavy Pistol (Armor-Piercing)
description: Double ablation to armor.

name: Nitro Ultra9
description: Can be poured into a Vehicle's tank to refill it as an Action. Gives bonuses to movement at the expense of safety. For more information, see Black Chrome Page 49.

name: Wall Art
description: Cheap poster.

name: Microwaver
description: An Exotic Very Heavy Pistol. Causes cyberware or electrical components to be rendered inoperable for a minute unless the target passes a DV15 Cybertech Check. Refer to the full item description on pg. 348.

name: AudioVox
description: Autotune synthesizer. Provides +2 to Acting and Play Instrument checks.

name: Popup Net Launcher
description: A concealable exotic net launcher. Can't hold anything with this hand while activated. (See Black Chrome pgs. 20-21 for more details)

name: Rippers
description: Very sharp fingernails which are a Medium Melee Weapon. Can be concealed.

name: Brain Injury
description: -2 to actions.

name: Verdant Knight
description:
The classic sword-and-board Cyberdeck build is highly effective against Black ICE. Just don’t plan on going toe-to-toe with a hostile Netrunner. 
 9 slots only for Programs. 
 Slots only accept Sword or Shield Programs.

name: Techhair
description: +2 Grooming with Chemskin. Color changing hair.

name: Discount Cyberaudio Suite
description: A cheap and bulky interface for an audio enhancement. (see Black Chrome pg. 17 for more details)

name: M-02 Rounds
description: Special Armor-Piercing rounds for use only in the Sternmeyer M-02 Heavy Rifle. Comes in a drum of 80.

name: Superbike
description: A beefed-up version of a roadbike, capable of very high speeds.

name: Generic Chic Bottoms
description: The kind of clothing you find in the Mega-Plexes of the Dark Future. Perfect if you don't want to stand out from a crowd.

name: Infrared Nightvision Scope
description: Reduces penalties against targets in darkness, smoke/fog to 0.

name: Olfactory Boost
description: Chipware. Allows scent tracking

name: Spinal Injury
description: Next turn: No action, move only.

name: Chyron
description: Tiny screen in your eye. Provides picture-in-picture for those boring moments.

name: Streetcase
description: Can carry many easily accessible items that YOU need to stay safe. For more information, see Black Chrome Page 47.

name: Digital Gladiator
description:
An app for your agent. Create a virtual Solo and take your fights into the digital realm! 
 Rules for fights can be found on page 12.

name: Aerozep
description: A modern-day cargo blimp. Requires a minimum of two rooms. The price is for each room below deck.

name: ST-5 Assault Rifle
description: A - relatively - reliable gun. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) you must then toss a coin; if you win the gun fires as normal, while if you lose the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

name: TearJerker
description: This weapon can only fire Smoke or Teargas Ammunition.

name: Heavy Pistol (Junk)
description: Junk ammo; cheap but deals 1d6 less damage against anyone with more than 1SP.

name: Grundy
description:
Armored industrial looking Compact Grouncar, with a powerful combat plow. 
 Full details can be found on page 68.

name: FleshWeave (Armor)
description: Armor Item for Sycust FleshWeave Cyberware.

name: Lost Ear
description: Ear is removed. If move more than 4m/yds in a Turn, cannot move next turn. -4 to hearing based Perception.

name: Rifle (Rubber)
description: Does not cause Critical Injury. Does not ablate armor. Leaves target at minimum 1hp. Counts as Basic ammo for exotic weapons

name: Flamethrower
description: An Exotic Shotgun that uses the Heavy Weapons Skill. Refer to the full item description on pg. 348.

name: Housing Capacity
description:
Can be applied to Aerozep, AV-4, Cabin Cruiser, Groundcars and Yacht. When installed onto a Groundcar or AV-4, it adds a sleeping area with 1 bed, a toilet, a shower, and a small kitchen to the vehicle. When installed into a Cabin Cruiser, Yacht, or Aerozep, it adds one room to the vehicle.  
  Requires a Heavy Chassis on a Compact Groundcar and High Performance Groundcar .

name: Raven
description: Effect: Derezzes a single Defender Program the enemy Netrunner has Rezzed at random, then deals 1d6 damage direct to the Netrunner's brain.

name: DeckKRASH
description: Forces Netrunner to Jack Out unsafely.

name: Nova Model 757 Cityhunter
description:
This pistol fires it's own custom rounds bought in packs of 18, though they cost the same as a pack of 10. Comes with a Smartgun Link*. 
  *Smartgun Link must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

name: Heavy Armorjack (Head)
description: Heavier version of an Armorjack for your head. -2 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

name: Arrow
description: Basic ammo, nothing special.

name: Shotgun Slug (Rubber)
description: Does not cause Critical Injury. Does not ablate armor. Leaves target at minimum 1hp. Counts as Basic ammo for exotic weapons

name: Damaged Ear
description: If move more than 4m/yds in a Turn, cannot move next turn. -2 to hearing based Perception.

name: Typhoid Speaker
description: When linked to a KillStrom Sonic Boom Amp, increases the DV of the Resist Torture/Drugs Check. For more information, see Black Chrome Page 41.

name: Sliver
description:
A Roadbike with all the gadgets you'd ever need. 
 Full details can be found on page 84.

name: Tech-Assault III
description: A concealable SMG.  If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

name: Shortsword
description: A short bladed, hilted weapon. Specifically designed for cutting or thrusting.

name: Heavy Melee (Poor)
description:
Generic Poor Quality Heavy Melee Weapon. 
 If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit Fail) the weapon fails in some way and requires an action to be made usable again.

name: Combat Plow
description: Can be applied to all land and sea vehicles, except Bikes and Jetskies. When you ram something with the front of your vehicle, your vehicle doesn't take damage and nobody inside suffers from the Whiplash critical injury. You deal 2d6 additional ramming damage if your vehicle was boosted by NOS on the turn you ram the object.

name: Damaged Eye
description: -2 to Ranged and Perception (Sight).

name: Superchrome Covering (Cyber Leg)
description: A metallic coating for your leg. Provides +2 to Wardrobe and Style.

name: M-02 Heavy Rifle
description: This weapon fires it's own custom ammunition, priced at 500eb (Expensive) for 80 rounds of Armor-Piercing ammo.

name: Chupacabra
description:
Compact Groundcar built from recycled parts from older vehicles. Low-tech but high-horse-power. 
 Full details can be found on page 66.

name: Urban Flash Footwear
description: The most technological and flashy clothing you can find in the Time of the Red.

name: Nomad Leathers Glasses
description: If you want to look like a chromed-up cowboy, this is perfect for you.

name: Stim
description: Injecting a target with Stim causes them to ignore all penalties from being Seriously Wounded for one hour. It can only be used on a target once per day.

name: MechaMan Motorcycle Helmet
description:
A Kevlar motorcycle helmet with integrated smart glasses that come with Chyron and Low Light / IR / UV pre-installed*. Refer to full item description on BC pg. 37. 
  *Smart Glasses and associated cyberware must be manually added and installed after acquring the armor.

name: Helicopter
description: A four-seater helicopter capable of high speeds and long flights.

name: Ebi
description:
Small but well thought out Compact Groundcar. 
 Full details can be found on page 72.

name: Mimic Clothing (Generic Chic)
description: Light Armorjack made from a Mimic Clothing Kit and "Generic Chic" clothing. Refer to full item description on BC pg. 33.

name: Scorpion
description:
A crossbow, reloaded as part of an Attack Action. 
 +1 to Attack.

name: Sniper Rifle
description: A long-distance sniper rifle. Holds 4 bullets in a magazine.

name: Grenade (Sleep)
description: Deals no damage. If meat target hit DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs. On fail falls Prone (see pg. 169) and unconscious for 1 minute. Can be woken by damage or another person using an action to touch/shake them.

name: Phoenix
description:
Never lose a Program again. 
 6 slots for Programs or Hardware. 
 Any Program destroyed in a netrunning session is restored upon a safe Jack Out.

name: City Reaper
description: A heavy SMG. Due to its size it can't be concealed.  If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

name: Perseus
description: The Militech Perseus is an Excellent Quality Exotic Very Heavy Pistol. Full Rules can be found in Black Chrome on Page 112.

name: Extended Magazine (Assault Rifle)
description: Increases magazine size to a hefty 35 bullets.

name: Kaliya
description:
A fantastic option for dismantling hostile Netrunners. Just hope they don’t have any Black ICE. 
 6 slots for Programs or Hardware, 3 extra slots only for Flak programs. 
 Restrictions for Defender Programs and Black ICE: Only Flak and Asp can be installed in any slot.

name: Ulični Uništitelj (Street Destroyer)
description: The Rostović Ulični Uništitelj (Street Destroyer) is a Poor Quality Exotic Shotgun. The magazine only holds 3 shots. It can only shoot Shotgun Shells. Full rules can be found in Black Chrome on Page 117.

name: SportMaster
description: A sport rifle, for fun, not people. Can only load Small Game Ammunition and is incapable of Autofire and Suppressive Fire.

name: Super Groundcar
description: An expensive, exotic CHOOH2 powered sportscar. It is capable of very high speeds.

name: Homing Tracer Cyberfinger
description: Cyberfinger that functions like a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.gear.QIHx5oQOirtTlAaD]{Homing Tracer}. Can only be installed on a modular finger cyberhand. (See Black Chrome pg. 25 for more details)

name: Radio Scanner/Music Player
description: Receive radio transmissions. Range: 1 mile.

name: Ranger Combat Boomerang
description:
Acts like a one Handed Exotic Heavy Melee, though halves SP despite being thrown. 
 Contains a built in guidance system, details of which can be found on page 100.

name: Medium Armorjack (Body)
description: Medium version of an Armorjack. -2 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

name: Gang Colors Top
description: Show your allegiance with Gang colors!

name: Asp
description: Effect: Destroys a single Program installed on the enemy Netrunner's Cyberdeck at random.

name: Extended Magazine (Sniper Rifle)
description: Increases magazine size to a hefty 8 bullets.

name: Banshee Microphone
description: Wireless Microphone Headset. Gives the User a +2 bonus to Play Instrument (Singing) Skill Checks while worn. Doesn't stack with other bonuses to Play Instrument. For additional information, see Black Chrome Page 40.

name: Spiked Bat (Excellent)
description: An advancement over a regular bat. A number of nails have been hammered through towards the tip.  +1 to Attack.

name: Businesswear Footwear
description: Your typical corporative clothing. Show everyone that you're here and you mean business.

name: Flashlight
description: 10h of light on a single charge. 100m/yd range.

name: One Touch Habitat
description: Provides protection from Exposure. Counts as Sleeping in the Wilderness or as Sleeping on the Streets. For more information, see Black Chrome Page 48.

name: Greataxe
description: A wooden pole with a curved blade on each side. Favoured by raid parties for close engagements. Requires 2 hands to wield even by a wielder with Body 8 or higher.

name: Mini Air Supply Cyberfinger
description: Cyberfinger with an integrated air tank. Can only be installed on a modular finger cyberhand. (See Black Chrome pg. 26 for more details)

name: Big Dreem
description: Exotic SMG. Autofire only. Even if you drop the weapon, it will continue to Autofire.

name: Mono-Katana Solo Wolf and Bot
description:
Poor Quality Two Handed Exotic Very Heavy Melee Weapon. 
 Mono-Katana cheap look-alike. Rules for spotting them apart can be found on page 92.

name: Contraceptive Implant
description: Prevents undesired pregnancy.

name: Mark III
description: A concealable, heavy pistol.

name: Onboard Flamethrower
description:
Can be applied to all vehicles.   A  Flamethrower  that can be mounted facing the front, side or back of the vehicle. The driver may fire it using an Action. It cannot be reloaded while driving, and cannot accept weapon attachments. 
 You may install this upgrade multiple times.

name: Extended Magazine (Heavy SMG)
description: Increases magazine size to a hefty 50 bullets.

name: Medium Pistol (Poor)
description: A concealable, medium-sized pistol. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

name: Very Heavy Pistol (Junk)
description: Junk ammo; cheap but deals 1d6 less damage against anyone with 1SP or more.

name: Giant
description: Effect: Does 3d6 damage direct to an enemy Netrunner's brain. The Netrunner is forcibly and unsafely Jacked Out of their current Netrun. They suffer the effect of all Rezzed enemy Black ICE they've encountered in the Architecture as they leave, not including the Giant.

name: Arrow (Rubber)
description: Does not cause Critical Injury. Does not ablate armor. Leaves target at minimum 1hp. Counts as Basic ammo for exotic weapons

name: Heavy Pistol (Small Game)
description: Small game ammo; not great for people. Deals 2d6 less damage.

name: Urban Flash Contact Lenses
description: The most technological and flashy clothing you can find in the Time of the Red.

name: Naginata (Excellent)
description: A japanese wooden pole with a curved blade on one side. Favoured by Arasaka tactical teams for close engagements.  +1 to Attack.

name: MegaHauler
description:
Armored truck transport. As much a train as a car. 
 Full details can be found on page 79.

name: Grenade (Armor-Piercing)
description: Double ablation to armor.

name: SDF-45
description: This rocket launcher can only load Armor-Piercing rockets, and has a maximum range of 400 m/yds. When fired one rocket at a time, the GM chooses where they rockets land. When fired two rockets at a time, the GM chooses where the rockets land but this time up to 50 m/yds away from the target, and with each rocket more than 10 m/yds from each other.

name: Perfume Shoppe
description: Skunk Black ICE will only take 1 option slot to install.

name: Vial of Biotoxin
description: 3d6 damage unless Resist Torture/Drugs. Armor does not apply.

name: Hello Cutie Ultra-K8 Assault Pistol
description: The Sanroo Hello Cutie Ultra-K8 Assault Pistol is an Excellent Quality Exotic Very Heavy Pistol with an Excellent Quality Heavy SMG mode. Full rules can be found in Black Chrome on Page 118.

name: Home Defender
description: An all-purpose shotgun.  If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

name: Rocket Launcher (Excellent)
description: Bring out the big guns. This rocket launcher will do some damage. +1 to Attack.

name: Radio Communicator
description: Built in walkie-talkie. 1 mile range.

name: Slice 'N Dice
description: Monofilament wiring which is a Medium Melee Weapon. Can be concealed.

name: Combat Recorder
description:
Real-world Combat data is invaluable for Black ICE development. 
 If another Netrunner in the same NET Architecture fails a Death Save, the last 5 minutes of non-self incriminating Netrun combat data is saved to the Cyberdeck. Recordings can be sold for 50eb.

name: Hot-Weather Jacket Lining
description:
Upgrade for any Jacket fashion item. User will not suffer Exposure penalties from hot temperatures (CP:R pg 181).  
 Heatwaves double all penalties from heavier armor (NCW pg 5).  For example, a user with Medium Armorjack takes a -4 penalty to MOVE, DEX, and REF during a Heatwave. Hot-Weather Jacket Lining decreases each of these penalties by 1.

name: PerfectFit Cyberfoot
description: Adjust foot size to perfectly fit any footwear. User can ignore penalties for wearing footwear that would otherwise be uncomfortable or impracticable. Can be installed in meat leg if it’s the only piece of cyberware in that leg.

name: TeleOptics
description: Telescope in your eye up to 800m/yds. +1 to single shot/aimed shot if greater than 50m away.

name: Generic Chic Contact Lenses
description: The kind of clothing you find in the Mega-Plexes of the Dark Future. Perfect if you don't want to stand out from a crowd.

name: Hardened Circuitry
description: Cyberdeck cannot be disabled or destroyed by EMP effects.

name: Laser Pointer Cyberfinger
description: Cyberfinger holding a concealed Laser Pointer. Can only be installed on a modular finger cyberhand. (See Black Chrome pg. 25 for more details)

name: Tech Bag
description: Tool bag.

name: Prime Time
description:
Primary Effect  
 Dose last 4 Hours. 
 
 Sharpens focus and willpower at the cost of dampened emotions

A classic Roadbike.

Exotic Sniper Rifle. Can load non basic ammunition.

name: Herakles
description:
AV4 type troop transport, armored and armed.

description:
Functions like a standard grenade launcher, but with a magazine size of 1. Requires 2 hands to use, and takes up 2 attachment slots. While attached, the weapon can't be concealed under clothing.

name: Linear Frame β (Beta)
description: Exoskeleton. Requires 2 Interface Plugs. Increases BODY to 14 while plugged in. No changes to your HP or Deathsave.

Excellent Quality One Handed Exotic Medium Melee Weapon.

name: Door Cracker

name: Bearcat

A revitalized bow, reloaded as part of an Attack Action. 
 +1 to Attack.

Bike is now more resistant: +5 SDP and rider can be BODY 11 or more. 
 Can't install this Upgrade with Folding Frame Upgrade.

name: Grenade Launcher (Excellent)
description: A high-impact grenade launcher. You can use a variety of grenades with this. +1 to Attack.

description: The Georgia Arms Matchmaker is a Poor Quality Exotic Shotgun that only holds one shot in the magazine. Full rules can be found in Black Chrome on Page 105.

description: Can be activated as an Action. When active, user may ignore the effects of wound states for 60 seconds (20 Rounds). Mortally Wounded characters must still make Death Saves.  After expiry, Berserk can not be activated again for 1 hour.

name: Advanced Quickhacks (DV12)

name: Neuroport Cyberdeck Port
description: Allows the user to use a compatible cyberdeck in an action via the Neuroport. Compatible Cyberdecks are unable to accept hardware options.  Cyberdeck Range is increased to 20 m/yds (10 squares) when connecting to NET Architectures. Range of 50 m/yds (25 squares) When connecting to other Neuroports. Walls block access.  Cyberdeck must be purchased separately. Only one port may be installed.

name: Difficult Quickhacks (DV10)
description: Netrunners in the 2070s gain access to Difficult Quickhacks at Inferface 3. These do not need to be installed in a Cyberdeck, and are gained automatically. (see more information on Edgerunners Mission Kit Rule Book pg.16)

name: Personal Link
description: Plugs in the wrist or head to allow you to connect to machines/systems hands-free.

name: Medium Pistol (Improved Smart)
description: Req Smart Weapon (does not include Smartgun Link). User ignores all visual penalites when using Improved Smart Ammunition. If an attack misses by 5 or less, replace your bonus with 14 You may still add luck.

name: Technical
description: Used for skills which rely on base INT or TECH.

name: Lowdown
description:
Used as a replacement for skills rolled with base COOL, EMP, or WILL 
 Used for rolling in checks which involve force of will, charisma, general intelligence, or intution. Note that if the check is specialized and the mook is not, the DV should be raised 1-3 tiers.

description: Used as a replacement for skills which rely on base Body or Dex, which are not covered by the Martial skill, and for Evasion.

description: Used as a replacement for fighting or ranged weapon skills, excluding evasion. Note that this uses REF as a base for reasons involving initiative - set REF of the mook first, then consider that number when considering the Martial skill.
